description: I no longer play to win , coming 3rd is just fine 🍾 #advocateforyourself #fyp #criticalthinking
transcript: I no longer care to win. I no longer hold space for the need to overwhelm myself or put myself in situations where I move and go into exhaustion because I've done so much and given so much of myself. Then learning that I've simplified my life. I have been the most comfortable, the more simple my life becomes. I am no longer chasing anything and this is such a realization of what happens post-healing. There is this weird in-between season after healing where the peace just overwhelms me and I'm no longer in a space where I have to chase anything.
